d:
After visiting all 197 countries in the world, it was finally time to head back home to India. I had spent one unforgettable week in São Paulo, Brazil, staying with a local friend, but after months and years of travelling, I was starting to feel a little homesick. I missed home, and I knew it was time to return.
I booked my flight from São Paulo to Chicago, and from there, I was supposed to continue my journey to Bengaluru, India. But this was not going to be an ordinary journey.
